div.l: And peyned here / to conterfete chere
Of coort / and to be estatlich of manere
And to be holden / digne of reuerence
But for to speke / of here conscience
She was so charitable / and pytous
She wolde wepe / and she sey a movs
Cawht in a trappe / if it were dede or bledde
Of smale hoıı̄undes / had she that she fedde
With rosted flesh / or mylk or wastilbrede
But sore wepte she / if any of hem were dede
Or if mēn smyte it / with a yerde smerte
And al was conscience / and tendre herte
Wel semely / here wympyl pynched was
Here nose streyht / here eyen grey as glas
Here mouth smale / and therto softe and reed
But sekirly / she had a fayre forhed
It was Almost / a spanne brod / I trowe
For hardely / she was nat vndir growe
Wel fetys was here cloke / as I was war
Of smal coral / a bowte here arm she bar
A peyre of bedys / gavded al with grene
And ther on heng / a broch of gold ful shene
On which ther was / firste writen a crowned A
And After / Amor Vincit Omnia
Another nonne Also / with here hadde she
That was here chapeleyn / and prestis thre
A Monke ther was / a fayr for the maistrie
And owt rydere / that loved venerye
A manly man / to ben an Abot Able
Full many a deynte hors / had he in his stable
And whan he rood / men myghte his brydel here
Gyngelyng in A whisteling wynde / as clere
And eke as lowde / as dothe the chapel belle
